description.value: Superbaba is a made-from-scratch Middle Eastern fast-food restaurant near the corner of Main Street and Broadway in Vancouver, with pita baked in-house daily and a menu built around wraps, falafel, and bowls. It is a three-time Best Casual Restaurant gold winner in Vancouver Magazine and has been featured on Food Network's Big Food Bucket List. Cyclists on the busy Main Street corridor will find a quick, well-regarded stop for dine-in or takeout.
